messages.author: 96ac8657240877c2
messages.subject: base_family
parts:
Hi,

is there a way to query the current font family? theme_get() shows
something like:

theme_text(family = base_family, ...)

But I'd like to know what the base_family is for generating plots in
other software so they look homogeneous when integrated in a document.

Thanks,

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: base_family
parts:
e.g.,

get("family", environment(theme_get()$legend.title))

returns the font family for legend.title.
